version: 0.5.3
tagline: Enrage countdown for about 380 bosses, plus reruns that keep your party. The first version that arrives by itself.

## New
- ⏱️ **Enrage countdown for ~380 bosses:** nearly every dungeon and field boss now counts down to its Frenzy, with boss data from [aion2.gg](https://aion2.gg). New times after a patch arrive without a new meter version
- ⬆️ **Arrives by itself:** 0.5.2 users get this version automatically the next time they start the meter

## Fixed
- 🔁 **Reruns in place (Vakron Sky Island):** the party stays, the panel shows *✓ Entering · Rerun* until the first pull and no longer pops up mid-run
